method: Effective price per actual kg vs original

from fractions import Fraction as F
p=F(72,10)/F(9,10); ch=abs((p-10)/10*100)
opts={'A':10,'B':15,'C':25,'D':20}
assert ch==opts['D']
for k in 'ABC': assert ch!=opts[k]

p=s.symbols('p'); v=s.solve(15*10+5*p-20*30,p)[0]
opts={'A':90,'B':70,'C':60,'D':80}

for k in 'BCD': assert v!=opts[k]

import sympy as s

opts={'A':40,'B':45,'C':35,'D':30}

for k in 'ABD': assert v!=opts[k]

import sympy as s

v=1/sc+2*sc
opts={'A':2,'B':3,'C':6,'D':1}

for k in 'ACD': assert v!=opts[k]

steps: Triangles XQO and ZPO: right angles, vertical angles at O, XQ=ZP
check_code:
import sympy as s
# place WY on x-axis, O at origin; X above at angle a, Z opposite direction
a=s.Rational(3,5)  # sin of angle between diagonals (any value works)
OX=12; OZ=s.symbols('OZ',positive=True)
XQ=OX*a; ZP=OZ*a
oz=s.solve(XQ-ZP,OZ)[0]
v=OX+oz
opts={'A':18,'B':24,'C':36,'D':12}
assert v==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert v!=opts[k]

method: Direct variation with square of weight

import sympy as s
u=s.symbols('u')
parts=[4,3,2,1]
orig=sum(parts)**2*u; pieces=sum(p*p for p in parts)*u
uv=s.solve(orig-pieces-63000,u)[0]
v=orig.subs(u,uv)
opts={'A':80000,'B':90000,'C':86000,'D':75000}
